sentences.show: Students asked to read their demands on the radio. That night, Stalin's statue had fallen, and only his boots were left.
The Hungarian Revolution began on this day in 1956.
University students in Budapest called people to march for freedom from Soviet control.
The crowd sang a banned patriotic poem.
Students went into the state radio building to broadcast 16 demands. They were detained.
Outside, the secret police opened fire.
Across the city, the crowd pulled down an 8-metre statue of Stalin.
Only the boots stayed on the plinth. They planted a Hungarian flag in them.
For a few days, the revolution seemed to win.
Then, on November 4th, Soviet tanks rolled in.
Also on this day: Santos-Dumont flew his fourteen-bis, and Irish rebels tried to seize Dublin Castle.
